shown.message:
I merged #29 into `main` and opened #30, `main` (98403e7) into `final`, for `internal-review` to approve. Approval of #30 is what releases the world.

- **#29:** `experiment-repo` approved after my P6 appendix fix. `figtab-repo` approved at 831849a, but the push of 803e4e9 dismissed that approval as stale. 803e4e9 touched only `paper/`, not their paths, and the merge went through without a fresh approval from them.
- **Page fit:** the last local build, run before the merge, ended the main text on page 9. I haven't looked at the official `document`-branch build, so page fit and anonymity there are unchecked.
- **#12:** I posted that #30 is offered. I won't push or merge anything into `main` while #30 is open.
